question.problem:
$$
f(x)∼\frac{{a}_{0}}{2}+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{n}\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{3}x)+{b}_{n}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{3}x)
$$

Let $F(x)=2x+7$ for $x\in [-3,3).$ The Fourier series of the $6$-periodic extension $f(x)$ of $F(x)$ is shown above. Find the exact value of ${a}_{1}.$

${a}_{1}=$ {{field-1}}
question.worked_solution:
For the Fourier series of a $2L$-periodic function, the cosine coefficients are given by

$$
{a}_{n}=\frac{1}{L}{\int }_{-L}^{L}f(x)\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{L}x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

In our case, $L=3$ and $f(x)=2x+7$ for $x\in [-3,3).$ So, substituting into the formula, we get

$$
{a}_{1}=\frac{1}{3}{\int }_{-3}^{3}(2x+7)\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi }{3}x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

We use the integration by parts: 

$$
\begin{aligned}u=2x+7\, & ⇒\,{u}^{′}=2 \\ {v}^{′}=\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi }{3}x)\, & ⇒\,v=\frac{3}{\pi }\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{\pi }{3}x)\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{1} & =\frac{1}{3}(uv\,{|}_{-3}^{3}-{\int }_{-3}^{3}v{u}^{′}\,\text{d}x) \\  & =\frac{1}{3}(\frac{3}{\pi }{[(2x+7)\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{\pi }{3}x)]}_{-3}^{3}-{\int }_{-3}^{3}\frac{3}{\pi }\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{\pi }{3}x)\cdot 2\,\text{d}x) \\  & =\frac{1}{3}(\frac{3}{\pi }[13\operatorname{sin}⁡(\pi )-\operatorname{sin}⁡(-\pi )]-\frac{6}{\pi }{\int }_{-3}^{3}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{\pi }{3}x)\,\text{d}x) \\  & =\frac{1}{3}(\frac{3}{\pi }\cdot 0-\frac{6}{\pi }\cdot (-\frac{3}{\pi }){[\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi }{3}x)]}_{-3}^{3}) \\  & =\frac{1}{3}(\frac{18}{{\pi }^{2}}[\operatorname{cos}⁡(\pi )-\operatorname{cos}⁡(-\pi )]) \\  & =\frac{6}{{\pi }^{2}}(-1-(-1)) \\  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
